ModMetaData.name: mulld Priorities
ModMetaData.author: mulld
ModMetaData.description:
Colony needs, useful work, and reviewable priority changes.
HOW TO OPEN Enable Harmony and mulld Priorities, then restart RimWorld. Load a colony, open Work, and click the mulld Priorities control above the grid to expand the panel.
Choose a preset or edit Rules, click the eye to Preview Changes, then Apply. The disk saves a custom preset.
Includes food, care and harvest indicators; primary work and backups; locks, exclusions and undo. Automation and diagnostics are off by default.
Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. Standard Off / 1–4 priorities.
